title: Blueprints
intro: User-definable entity kinds (Port compatibility, phase 1): typed properties, relations, mirror/calculation/aggregation properties and ownership. Administrators define blueprints; everyone can read them.

hint.icon: The NAME of a Port icon (e.g. Microservice) — a free string, not a picture.
hint.pattern: A regular expression the value must match.
hint.enumValues: The closed list a property may pick from — press Enter to add each value.
hint.objectSchemaJson: properties / patternProperties / additionalProperties, as raw JSON — stored and shape-checked only.
hint.path: Dot-separated relation identifiers, ending in a property or a $meta name (e.g. system.domain.$title).
hint.calculation: A jq expression over the entity — stored as text, never evaluated here.
hint.colors: A JSON object mapping calculated values to one of Port's 14 colours.
hint.query: Port's search-rule syntax ({ combinator, rules }) — stored and shape-checked only.

validation.identifier: Must be 1–100 characters of letters, digits, and [@_.:/=-], and not start with $
validation.title: Required, up to 100 characters
validation.propertyId: Must be 1–100 characters of letters, digits, and [@_.:/=-], and not start with $
validation.propertyIdDuplicate: Properties, mirror, calculation and aggregation properties share one namespace — this ID is already used
validation.relationId: Must be 1–100 characters of letters, digits, and [@_.:/=-], and not start with $
validation.relationIdDuplicate: A relation with this ID already exists
validation.relationRequiredMany: A relation cannot be both required and many
validation.minMax: The minimum must not exceed the maximum
validation.exclusiveConflict: Cannot set both an inclusive and an exclusive bound on the same side
validation.enumNumber: Every value must be a number
validation.defaultNumber: The default must be a number
validation.defaultNotInEnum: The default must be one of the allowed values
validation.pathFirstSegment: The first segment must name a relation of this blueprint
validation.aggregationPropertyForbidden: A property is not allowed when calculating by entities
validation.aggregationFunc: Not a valid function for this calculation

saveConflict: A blueprint with this identifier already exists
saveInvalid: One or more fields are invalid
saveGone: This blueprint no longer exists — reload the page
deleteConflict: This blueprint is still referenced by another blueprint's relation or aggregation property — remove or retarget it first
targetOptionsFailed: Could not load the blueprint list
